overview: An open-source React Native e-commerce mobile application (EasyBuy) built with Expo and Redux, featuring a mock Express API server for offline development and testing.

domain_models.name: User
domain_models.definition: A registered user of the platform. Roles include standard Customers (who can buy products, manage cart/wishlist, and place orders) and Admins (who manage inventory, categories, users, and orders via a management dashboard).

domain_models.name: Product
domain_models.definition: An item listed for sale on the platform. Contains title, category reference, price, description, quantity, and image path.

domain_models.name: Category
domain_models.definition: A taxonomy for organizing Products. Admins can create and manage categories (e.g., Garments, Electronics, Cosmetics, Groceries).

domain_models.name: Order
domain_models.definition: A completed transaction representing a customer's checkout. Tracks items purchased, total price, delivery address, and order/shipment status.

domain_models.name: Cart
domain_models.definition: A temporary collection of Products and their quantities chosen by a Customer prior to placing an Order. Managed via Redux state.

domain_models.name: Wishlist
domain_models.definition: A persistent list of saved Products that a Customer is interested in but has not yet added to their Cart.
